SOS_NSA.unit: pp, 52-week change of the 26-week average of CCNSA/COVEMP
SOS_NSA.vintage: administrative, unrevised (one-tick margin measured in collection 248)

LMSI30.unit: states of 51 whose 13-week average insured rate is >= 0.20 pp above a year earlier
LMSI30.vintage: ETA 539 c8/c18 by c2, administrative, unrevised

CFNAI.vintage: current (the Chicago Fed revises the index)

Michez.unit: points: the smaller of the unemployment indicator (Sahm form, first prints) and the vacancy indicator (12-month high of the 3-month mean vacancy rate over its value), line 0.29
Michez.vintage: first prints (UNRATE, JOLTS); payrolls the latest vintage

WEI.unit: 13-week mean of the index (scaled to four-quarter GDP growth, percent), line 0; the latest week 3.03
WEI.vintage: current (the Dallas Fed revises the index weekly; ALFRED vintages held from 16 April 2020)
